purpose: Observe a natural 'Why?' continuation while Open WebUI metadata tasks may still be using the same local model.

environment.hardware: NVIDIA RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU, 16 GiB; effective context 65,536
environment.composer_settlement: Wait 6 s after the first answer appears before submitting the follow-up, then verify the Stop control is absent. This avoids a prior immediate-submit probe that did not produce a second provider request.

samples.note: Exploratory outlier. This run used Stop-control settlement without the later fixed 6 s pause; no provider start timestamps were recorded.

summary.interpretation: Two fixed-settlement samples show no stable follow-up latency penalty; medians differ by -557 ms, far below this model's observed turn-to-turn variance. A separate ON exploratory sample took 68.459 s, showing a high-latency tail that needs more repetitions and queue instrumentation. Metadata calls demonstrably overlap the second chat request in one trace, but timing alone does not prove the runtime's internal scheduling or causation. Metadata adds two provider generations each conversation. The short 'Why?' answers were weak in both arms and are not quality-qualified.
summary.stop_route: UI issued two POST /api/tasks/chat/{id}/stop requests after completed turns in ON runs; both returned HTTP 200. The metadata generations still completed in the captured traces. Do not interpret these successful cleanup responses as metadata cancellation.
limitations: synthetic browser account, candidate services and one local model; no PLAIN STACK arm or owner preference
two fixed-settlement samples per arm, with run order not counterbalanced
warm/cold model state and output sampling contribute variance
the 68.459 s ON sample was exploratory and did not include provider interval timestamps
SSE frame counts are transport events, not token counts
answer correctness/naturalness was not independently graded
notification endpoint returned fixture 503 because feed credentials/URL were omitted; unrelated to per-turn metadata calls

cleanup: Temporary Ollama process stopped, port 11445 closed, candidate containers/network removed; production configuration unchanged.
